title: The Screwtape Letters
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: A senior demon, Screwtape, writes letters advising his nephew Wormwood on how to lead a man away from faith. The inverted view lets C. S. Lewis explore temptation and everyday moral failings.
readIf: you enjoy clever Christian satire and reflections on temptation and self-deception.
skipIf: you want a novel with a developed plot or are uninterested in religious ideas.
